translation: It grows on Mount Huayin. It is as large as a finger, two or three cun long, with six faces as if cut, white and clear with luster. Its yellow end with white edges is called Yellow Quartz [黃石英]; the red end is called Red Quartz [赤石英]; the blue end is called Blue Quartz [青石英]; the black end is called Black Quartz [黑石英].
